description: This is a React component named Navbar that implements a top navigation bar with branding and authentication controls for a web application. It includes navigation links, profile, login, and logout functionality.

methods.name: Navbar({ isAuthenticated, onLogout })
methods.description: Functional React component rendering the navigation bar with props for authentication status and logout handler.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by removing token from local storage, calling onLogout callback if provided, and navigating to the authentication page.
